quests.title: To Drudgerton!
quests.direction: Find Jellio at the southern entrance to Drudgerton (12.8S, 21.1W). The Thusik Ringway east of Linvak Tukal leads toward town.
quests.greeting: Welcome to Drudgerton. Jrent is at Linvak Tukal if you are looking for an introduction.
quests.welcome: Welcome to Drudgerton! Jrent sent you just in time for the Blazing Drudge Festival. Meet the other drudges while you are in town.

notes: The guide records level 40, a seven-day deadline and reset, 750,000 XP and 1,500 QP. The installed Legions quest export has no identified native quest ID for the introduction. 4000fe04 is a local journal identity.

Both NPCs were observed together in this retail capture with the visual, scale, orientation and positions below. Installed Legions lacks their named workbook templates; its records at the late capture IDs represent unrelated entities. The two named instances use compatible neutral Legions assets with the same PhysObj (470000c6 / 470000c8), visual, selection and entity type. The literal CREATE name and explicit instance-to-role mapping distinguish them from other instances of the same rendering template.
